subject.title: fix(msteams): preserve inbound activities before webhook ack

question: Is the supplied Microsoft Teams durability evidence sufficient to accept changed webhook acknowledgement and replay semantics, or should the PR provide an inspectable after-fix runtime artifact first?
rationale: Automated test claims establish useful coverage, but only a maintainer can decide whether the required real-environment proof and channel-delivery tradeoff are adequate for this protected delivery-path change.

options.title: Require runtime durability proof
options.body: Request a redacted terminal transcript, runtime logs, or recording that demonstrates durable append before acknowledgement and replay after restart on a Microsoft Teams-compatible path.

options.title: Accept the documented test evidence
options.body: Proceed with owner review based on the reported matrix and suite results while explicitly accepting the remaining real-environment proof gap.
